title: RAG_finance Phase 3 provisional product interface v1
$comment: Product-level agreement; NOT NB23 engine transport, NOT accepted runtime compatibility

locator.$comment: book_anchor requires work_id + edition_id + stable anchor; transcript_segment requires episode_id + stable segment_anchor. Missing page/timestamp stays null, never synthetic zero.

source_attribution.$comment: Optional display title of document/program may be retained with its claimed metadata origin; it does NOT prove resolution, attribution, source authorization or openable URL. Keep stable anchors as anchors; no guessed URL.

send_message_receipt.$comment: requested_conversation_id is the immutable original client request input, possibly null; resolved_conversation_id is a server-assigned non-null identifier on created/replayed, the same across safe replays, and null for conflict. No exactly-once model guarantee.

delete_command.$comment: Client request only: client_action_id is client-owned; request_id, trace_id, deletion_request_id and owner identity are server-owned. Confirmed user action is not server-confirmed deletion.

delete_status.$comment: Server-generated operation status. requesting/processing/succeeded/failed are server outcomes; transport unknown is strictly local client state, not server status. Operation ID is not authorization.

feedback_submit_request.$comment: Untrusted client request: no owner_user_id, request_id or trace_id. Identity is from server authenticated context. Retry must retain exact original payload.

feedback_submit_receipt.$comment: Only server-confirmed created/replayed receipts prove feedback persistence. Transport loss is locally unknown, never server-confirmed success.

delete_status_query.$comment: Client may request status by operation ID+action correlation, but this proves no ownership. Server MUST independently authenticate/authorize owner; post-account-deletion session access is unresolved and must not use anonymous bearer IDs.
